raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Error

MTP with native DSA-indexer decode above `next_n=2` crashes during warm-up on MI355X (seen at `next_n=3` and `next_n=6`). GLM-5.2-MXFP4, TP4, `num_speculative_tokens=5` (`next_n=6`), Gluon paged MQA logits:

```
Memory access fault by GPU node-4 (Agent handle: 0x20465ea0) on address 0x792dc0bf1000. Reason: Unknown.
```

Where it does not crash, the indexer silently uses wrong causal bounds: in a direct call at `next_n=3`, the 8192-token sequence loses its last 2 valid positions in every row (9/12 rows correct).

## Cause

With native decode (`next_n > 1`), `rocm_fp8_paged_mqa_logits` receives a `(B, next_n)` table of per-row context lengths, `[b, j] = L_b - next_n + j + 1`, built in [`indexer.py#L1136-L1152`](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/2df122e65e87dc12870ce5f0180b49f012e7a53b/vllm/v1/attention/backends/mla/indexer.py#L1136-L1152). The AITER Gluon `deepgemm_fp8_paged_mqa_logits` and `deepgemm_fp8_paged_mqa_logits_stage1` kernels read the table as a flat `[B]` array and some sequences get another row's length.

Example: 4 requests, `next_n=3`, context lengths 8192 / 1500 / 3000 / 700:

| `b` | `j=0` | `j=1` | `j=2` | `L_b` |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | 8190 | 8191 | **8192** | 8192 |
| 1 | 1498 | 1499 | **1500** | 1500 |
| 2 | 2998 | 2999 | **3000** | 3000 |
| 3 | 698 | 699 | **700** | 700 |

The kernel expects `[8192, 1500, 3000, 700]` and computes each row's bound itself. Reading the `(4, 3)` table as `[4]`, it gets the first four values in memory, `[8190, 8191, 8192, 1498]`: request 0 loses its last 2 positions in every row, and requests 1 to 3 get lengths past their own KV pages, the likely source of the fault. Column `j = next_n - 1` equals `L_b`, which is what the kernel needs.

## Fix

Pass the kernels the last column, which is the per-sequence length. `[B]` and `(B, 1)` inputs, the C4A Triton path and the torch fallback are unchanged.

On ROCm native decode is used for `next_n` 1 and 2 today, so MTP with one speculative token goes through this path. #59421 raises that cap, which needs this fix.

## Test Plan

- `pytest tests/v1/attention/test_rocm_paged_mqa_context_lens.py` (new): the helper returns the per-sequence lengths for a `(B, next_n)` table and passes `[B]` / `(B, 1)` through unchanged.
- Direct call of `rocm_fp8_paged_mqa_logits` on one MI355X against a torch reference: `B=4`, `next_n=3`, contexts 8192/1500/3000/700, block size 64.

## Test Result

| Gluon | Rows correct | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| This PR | 12/12 | max rel diff 2.4e-7 |
| Before | 9/12 | the 8192-token sequence loses its last 2 valid positions in every row |

With this fix, GLM-5.3 MTP at `next_n=3` and `next_n=5` completes the full throughput sweep, GPQA (0.889 / 0.904) and RULER niah_single_2 (1.0 / 1.0).


| next_n (spec tokens) | GPQA | NIAH | Geomean tok/s/GPU |
|---|---|---|---|
| no MTP | 0.879 | 1.00 | 2435.5 |
| 3 (2) | 0.889 | 1.00 | 3309.1 |
| 5 (4) | 0.904 | 1.00 | 3607.8 |

Throughput per GPU:

| Conc | 8k/1k no MTP | 8k/1k n=3 | 8k/1k n=5 | 60k/600 no MTP | 60k/600 n=3 | 60k/600 n=5 |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 4 | 544.4 | 1105.3 | 1337.0 | 2925.1 | 4067.3 | 4422.3 |
| 8 | 897.5 | 1650.6 | 2015.3 | 3889.2 | 4658.8 | 4408.6 |
| 16 | 1415.4 | 2177.6 | 2648.5 | 4550.6 | 4948.6 | 5050.4 |
| 32 | 2058.7 | 3061.8 | 3638.4 | 4938.2 | 5175.0 | 5303.4 |
| 64 | 2853.3 | 4013.9 | 4447.8 | | | |
| 128 | 3741.3 | 4715.5 | 4291.3 | | | |
| 256 | 4603.2 | 4663.6 | 5208.6 | | | |

The no-MTP run is the same setup without speculative decoding (decode paged MQA logits on the FlyDSL kernel instead of Gluon).

@@ -0,0 +1,32 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm._aiter_ops import is_aiter_found_and_supported
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+if not current_platform.is_rocm() or not is_aiter_found_and_supported():
+    pytest.skip("Requires ROCm with AITER.", allow_module_level=True)
+
+from vllm.v1.attention.ops.rocm_aiter_mla_sparse import _per_sequence_context_lens
+
+
+def test_per_row_table_uses_last_column():
+    seq_lens = torch.tensor([8192, 1500, 3000, 700], dtype=torch.int32)
+    next_n = 3
+    offsets = torch.arange(next_n, dtype=torch.int32) - next_n + 1
+    per_row = seq_lens.unsqueeze(1) + offsets
+
+    out = _per_sequence_context_lens(per_row)
+
+    assert out.shape == (4,)
+    assert out.is_contiguous()
+    assert torch.equal(out, seq_lens)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("shape", [(4,), (4, 1)])
+def test_per_sequence_input_is_unchanged(shape):
+    context_lens = torch.arange(1, 5, dtype=torch.int32).reshape(shape)
+    assert _per_sequence_context_lens(context_lens) is context_lens

@@ -707,6 +707,14 @@ def paged_mqa_logits_module():
     return None
 
 
+def _per_sequence_context_lens(context_lens: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    # AITER takes one length per sequence: the last column of a (B, next_n) table.
+    # TODO: remove once AITER accepts (B, next_n) context_lens (ROCm/aiter#6153).
+    if context_lens.dim() == 2 and context_lens.shape[1] > 1:
+        return context_lens[:, -1].contiguous()
+    return context_lens
+
+
 def rocm_fp8_paged_mqa_logits(
     q_fp8: torch.Tensor,
     kv_cache_fp8: torch.Tensor,

If we introduce the fix in aiter to accept a 2D context length array, then we might have to change other frameworks and other models that use this method. E.g. ATOM Deepseek v2/v32 passes the per batch context length - https://github.com/ROCm/ATOM/blob/868cb029cc154038fb748c24397afb35e7c2bc57/atom/model_ops/attentions/aiter_mla.py#L3031. 

Similar to ATOM, I could compute this in indexer metadata builder so that it removes that copy per step and instead turns it into a persistent buffer, and the AITER calls read it. @AndreasKaratzas which method do you recommend?

> I think this makes sense, as I understand it AITER expects 1d context lens (in contrast to Nv deepgemm expecting 2d) and then reconstructs the full one here https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/blob/4ee387457385e9e18c50c4c808b9b4d0300514d6/aiter/ops/triton/_triton_kernels/attention/pa_mqa_logits.py#L513.
>
